resources.string: Required to lock screen and expand notifications via gestures in NovaLauncher.

NovaLauncher uses the Accessibility Service exclusively to perform system global actions via gestures:

• Double tap: lock the screen.
• Swipe down: open the notification panel.

NovaLauncher does not use the service to read content from other applications, extract screen text, or record or transmit any accessibility event content.

These features are optional and will not be available if the service remains disabled.
Service active: lock screen and notification gestures enabled.
